name: smart-cobot-factory-mern
description: Smart Cobot Factory Management System — MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node) with Socket.IO

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && node scripts/setup-env.js
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix server
